unit.explanation: 9 advanced PDAC patients with matched PDOs and clinical outcome data

platform.explanation: Patient-derived pancreatic cancer organoids used for pharmacotyping

readout.explanation: Drug response measured via AUC of dose-response curves; lower AUC = higher sensitivity

direction.explanation: Lower AUC (blue fill) = sensitive, higher AUC (red fill) = resistant

threshold_rule.explanation: Sensitive = lowest 33% AUC of 66 PDO cohort; Resistant = highest 34% AUC

threshold_timing.explanation: Thresholds defined on full 66-PDO cohort prior to evaluating the 9 patients

patient_mapping.explanation: Each patient has a uniquely matched PDO

regimen_match.explanation: PDO sensitivity evaluated for the same chemotherapies the patient received

n_units.explanation: 9 patients in the retrospective concordance analysis

split.explanation: 9 patients are a subset of the 66-PDO cohort; no independent held-out split
